scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Welcome
to ^8B4513Einbroch^000000,
the City of Steel.
Please ask me if you
have any questions.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
欢迎来到^8B4513艾音布罗克^000000，
钢铁之城。
如果您有任何问题，请随时向我咨询。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
The {0} is located
in the northwestern part
of the city. There you can
see our city's pride and joy, the Airship. Remember that you must pay admission to board the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
{0}位于城市的西北部。
在那里您可以看到我们城市的骄傲——飞空艇。
请记住，乘坐飞空艇需要支付入场费。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
The {0}, perhaps the
most important facility in
Einbroch, is located in the
southern part of the city.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
{0}可能是艾音布罗克最重要的设施，
位于城市的南部。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
The {0}, our biggest
shopping district, can be
found just east from the
center of Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
{0}是我们最大的购物区，
位于艾音布罗克中心以东。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
The {0} is east of
the Plaza and offers top
caliber accomodations.
There, you can enjoy your
stay in Einbroch in comfort~
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
{0}位于广场以东，
提供顶级的住宿服务。
在那里，您可以舒适地享受在艾音布罗克的停留~

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
The {0} is
located in the northeast
part of Einbroch. Trains
running between here
and Einbech run all day
long, everyday.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
{0}位于艾音布罗克的东北部。
往返于这里和艾音贝赫的火车
全天运行，每天如此。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
The {0} is
located north from the
Plaza. There you can
purchase weapons for
your personal use.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
{0}位于广场以北。
在那里您可以购买
供个人使用的武器。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
The {0} is an
annex of the Factory and
is located in the southwest
sector of Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
{0}是工厂的附属设施，
位于艾音布罗克的西南部。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
I will mark the location
of the {0}
on your mini-map.
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
我将在您的小地图上
标记{0}的位置。
您还想查看其他地点吗？

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
The {0} is
located in the southeast
part of Einbroch. You can
upgrade your equipment
by using their services.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
{0}位于艾音布罗克的东南部。
您可以使用他们的服务
来升级您的装备。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
You may go to ^FF1493Manthasman^000000,
the ^FF1493Armsmith^000000
on the 1st basement floor in the Blacksmith Guild.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
您可以前往^FF1493曼萨曼^000000，
他是位于铁匠公会的
地下一层的^FF1493武器匠^000000。

您还想查看其他地点吗？

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
You can find
the ^CD1039Eden Teleport Officer^000000
on the 1st floor of the Gunslinger Guild.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
您可以在神枪手公会的
一楼找到^CD1039乐园团传送官^000000。

我将移除您小地图上的标记。
您还需要其他帮助吗？

[艾音布罗克向导]
祝您旅途愉快！

scripts.text:
[Einbech Guide]
Welcome to ^8B4513Einbech^000000,
the Mining Town. We're
here to assist tourists,
so if you have any questions,
please feel free to ask us.
scripts.translation:
[艾音贝赫向导]
欢迎来到^8B4513艾音贝赫^000000，
这里是采矿城镇。我们在这里
为游客提供帮助，
如果您有任何问题，
请随时向我们咨询。
[酒馆]
[ 工具店 ]
[火车站]
[矿场]
[ 卡普拉 职员 ]

scripts.text:
[Einbech Guide]
The {0} is located
in the southern part of
Einbech. It's a nice place
to relax after a long day.
scripts.translation:
[艾音贝赫向导]
{0}位于
艾音贝赫的南部。
这是一个在忙碌一天后
放松身心的好地方。

scripts.text:
[Einbech Guide]
You can find the {0} in the center of
Einbech. There, you can
purchase any tools you
might need for your travels.
scripts.translation:
[艾音贝赫向导]
您可以在艾音贝赫的中心
找到{0}。在那里，
您可以购买旅行中
可能需要的任何工具。

scripts.text:
[Einbech Guide]
The {0} are
located in the northwest
and northeast parts of
Einbech. There, you can
take a train to Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[艾音贝赫向导]
{0}位于
艾音贝赫的西北部和
东北部。在那里，
您可以乘坐火车前往艾音布罗克。

scripts.text:
[Einbech Guide]
The {0}, which is
Einbech's major industry,
is located in the northern
part of this town. It's where
we get all our ores, although monsters get in the miners' way.
scripts.translation:
[艾音贝赫向导]
{0}是艾音贝赫的主要产业，
位于城镇的北部。我们所有的矿石
都来自那里，尽管魔物
总是阻碍矿工的工作。
